# Signet7

> Signet7 cryptographically seals email. It does not encrypt mail. Agents and people verify the original message bytes before acting on money-moving instructions.

Akasha is the name on the front door. The company is Signet7.

## What Signet7 does

Signet7 answers whether the words in an important email still match a cryptographic seal, and whether the sender's address is listed for the organization. You keep the file. The public check uploads are checked then deleted.

Signet7 seals; it does not encrypt. Do not rebuild From, To, Subject, or body for verify — submit original RFC 5322 bytes (`s7-email-1` / `.eml`).

## Verify (agents)

- HTTP: `POST https://verify.signet7.io/api/v1/email/verify` (Bearer token for automation). Planned integrator host: `https://api.signet7.io` (not live yet).
- MCP stdio command: `signet7-mcp`
- Shipped MCP tools: `signet7_check_email` (verify), `signet7_record_decision` (decision ledger). Upcoming names: `signet7_verify_email`, `signet7_seal_email` (see PLACEHOLDER on the agent docs page).
- Agent JSON verdict: `signet7.verify.v1` — fields `sealed`, `verdict` (`sealed`|`unsealed`|`tampered`|`revoked`|`unknown`), `signer`, `delegation` (`agent_label`, `principal`) or null, `receipt_id`, `checked_at`.

## Seal (outbound)

Humans seal with Signet7 desktop and sender tokens today. Delegated agent tokens and MCP seal tools are upcoming. Until then, agents should verify inbound mail and refuse when `verdict` is not `sealed`.

## Connect without leaking tokens

Device-code flow on `account.signet7.io`: `POST /api/v1/account/device/start`, human approves on phone, poll `POST /api/v1/account/device/poll`. Store tokens only in the MCP process environment.

## Caller enforces

Signet7 returns facts and optional allow/refuse on decision routes. Your agent must refuse spoofed wires and tampered mail. Treating the answer as a hint and executing anyway defeats the control.

## What is not claimed

Free email check. No hidden generative model on verify. Not a virus scanner, not payment approval, not legal advice. No customer logos or production SLAs on this export.
